name: hugmesh-e2e
description: Playwright integration tests: front page over generated certs, admin allowlist, Google/Discord registration gating, 5 users, Matrix chat, Mastodon posting, and the RBAC role matrix (gateway route-access ALLOW/DENY, games-admin gate, ROLE_MOD sibling scope, user/pending).

//test:rbac:contract: NAMED, DATED EXCEPTION — `--grep-invert @layer:ui` on test:rbac:contract. Re-checked 2026-09-09 (#326 item 1).

WHY IT IS NOT A MUTE: this lane is the OFFLINE contract lane — it asserts the route-access/role CONTRACT with no stack running. @layer:ui tests drive the live host shell (a real browser against a deployed UI), so in this lane they cannot pass; they are not failing tests being hidden, they are tests that belong to the live lane. Excluding by TAG, not by node id, is what keeps the lane self-maintaining: a UI test added to specs 12/16/18 later is excluded because of what it IS, not because someone re-pinned a list.

WHY IT IS WRITTEN DOWN AT ALL: PR #325 added this flag and explained it only in its commit message, while the same PR removed a --deselect from .gitlab-ci.yml whose stated reason had been false for months. A reason that lives only in a commit message rots exactly that way. package.json takes no comments, so it lives here.

MEASURED, and how to re-measure: `./node_modules/.bin/playwright test -c playwright.config.ts --list 12-rbac-gateway-route-access 16-rbac-mod-sibling-scope 18-rbac-phase8-10-pending` => Total: 68 tests in 3 files; add `--grep-invert @layer:ui` => Total: 64 (re-measured 2026-09-24, after the retired nav-admin stub). The 4 excluded are ALL in 18-rbac-phase8-10-pending.spec.ts:223 ('LIVE (Phase 8): host shell ROLE_GAMES games entry-point', personas e2e-gamesonly / e2e-gamesadmin / e2e-user / e2e-mod). Specs 12 and 16 carry ZERO @layer:ui tests today.

WHAT MAKES THIS STALE: the tag is generated by tags({layer:'ui'}) in specs/report-tags.ts (layerTag => `@layer:${layer}`), so it does NOT appear literally in the spec files and a grep for '@layer:ui' over specs/ finds only a comment. If that helper is renamed or the tag vocabulary changes, this flag silently stops excluding anything and the offline lane starts running live UI tests. Re-run the two --list counts above; if they are equal, this flag is dead and must be fixed or removed.
IF YOU WANT THE UI TESTS: run them in a lane that has a stack, e.g. `npm run test:rbac` (specs 12-18, no invert), against a live deployment.
